A vibrant celebration of Indian culture with music, dance, food, local makers, holiday shopping & family-friendly fun! Free & all ages.

About this Event

Colors of India-A Holiday Pop-Up Experience
Saturday, December 12th | 12–5 PM
SPARK Social San Jose
140 S. Montgomery Street, San Jose
FREE & ALL AGES

What to Expect:
🍛 Delicious Indian Food + Bay Area Flavors
🍹 Full Bars + Chai, Coffee & Sweet Treats
🛍️ Local Makers + Holiday Shopping
✨Family-Friendly Activities + Dedicated Kids Area
🎶 Signature Non Stop Bhangra Dance Party

🌻 Non Stop Bhangra is Coming to the South Bay!! 🌻
After 22 years of cultural celebrations, we're excited to bring Non Stop Bhangra to the South Bay with Colors of India — A Holiday Pop-Up Experience! ✨
Join us at SPARK Social San José, a vibrant new outdoor gathering space in the heart of Creekside in downtown San José, for a colorful afternoon of music, dance, delicious food, holiday shopping, and family-friendly fun!
Enjoy delicious Indian food from some of our favorite Bay Area vendors alongside SPARK Social's resident food trucks serving up a variety of local flavors. Explore a colorful marketplace of local makers and artisans, enjoy family-friendly activities alongside the venue's existing games and dedicated kids' area, and experience the signature Non Stop Bhangra energy with DJs, live dhol drumming, dance performances, interactive Bhangra lessons, and an open dance floor for everyone to join in!
If you love our Bhangra & Beats Night Market in San Francisco, you'll feel right at home. And if you're new to Non Stop Bhangra, we can't wait to celebrate with you! 💛
Indian-inspired fits encouraged! Bring your colors, sparkle, and festive spirit! ✨

***Colors of India is presented by Non Stop Bhangra and Creekside in partnership with SPARK Social San José

Parking & Getting Here:
Convenient parking available in the public lot across the street at 105 S. Montgomery Street, plus metered street parking throughout the surrounding area.
